description: Ministry of Finance - Finance Act No.11 of 1963 - Rules of the National Lotteries Board.
categorisation: This gazette contains rules and regulations made by the National Lotteries Board under the authority of the Finance Act No. 11 of 1963, which constitutes legal/regulatory content. It establishes the operational framework for national lotteries, including prize structures, ticket pricing, and distribution of proceeds, making it a statutory instrument rather than government personnel/structure matter.
